evals.prompt: Analyze this customer call transcript and extract PM-ready product feedback. Include what help is needed, customer scenario + desired outcome, customer impact, and workaround details. Also include severity, urgency, and feature area with evidence quotes. Transcript: "We onboard around 40 reps monthly. Permission setup is manual per user and takes 2-3 hours weekly. We use spreadsheets to copy settings and often miss one policy field."
evals.expected_output: Structured markdown + JSON output with all required sections and evidence-backed prioritization.

evals.prompt: From this transcript, produce high-quality product feedback and clearly score whether the evidence quality is good or excellent: "During month-end close, the approvals page times out at 45 seconds when filtering cost centers. It happens every cycle. 12 approvers are impacted and payouts are delayed by up to a week. We export CSV and split by region as workaround, but it still fails for large regions."
evals.expected_output: Likely excellent-quality extraction with quantified impact and explicit workaround constraints.

evals.prompt: Review this transcript and extract product-relevant feedback only: "Can someone share the slide deck? I like the new brand color. Let's reschedule because of vacation. Email me at alex@example.com and call +1 555 010 2222."
evals.expected_output: Insufficient signal result with redacted PII and explicit open questions.
